campaigns.title: One Breath
campaigns.audience: General public, weighted to men 40–60 (lowest help-seeking group)
campaigns.hero_line: It's okay to not be okay.
campaigns.body: Whatever today feels like, you don't have to carry it alone. Talk to someone. Call or text 1To1, free, any time. The first step is just one breath.
campaigns.outcome: Helpline contacts up 34% in 8 weeks; recall highest among target male audience; safe-messaging board approved with no changes.
campaigns.why_it_worked: Validated the feeling first, then gave one clear, low-effort action. Plain words, no judgement, helpline front and centre.

campaigns.title: Ask Twice
campaigns.hero_line: When someone says 'I'm fine' — ask twice.
campaigns.body: Sometimes 'I'm fine' means 'I'm not, but I don't know how to say it.' You don't need the right words. Just ask again, and listen. Need support? Text 1To1, any time.
campaigns.outcome: 1.2M organic reach; 400+ workplaces downloaded the toolkit; 22% lift in 'I would check on a colleague' survey measure.
campaigns.why_it_worked: Gave people a tiny, doable behaviour ('ask twice') instead of a lecture. Warm, plain, actionable.

campaigns.title: You're Allowed
campaigns.format: Creator-led short video + school assembly pack
campaigns.hero_line: You're allowed to not have it all figured out.
campaigns.body: Big feelings are normal. So is asking for help. Whatever you're going through, someone's ready to listen — no judgement. Text 1To1, free, any time.
campaigns.outcome: Reached 60% of national 16–24 cohort; helpline youth contacts up 28%; reviewed and cleared by youth-safeguarding panel.
campaigns.why_it_worked: Met young people where they are, with their cadence, without trying too hard. Normalised help-seeking and signposted clearly.
